title: Purple-team sidecar rules of engagement
description: Signed authorization artifact for the red-team sidecar. Absent, expired, unsigned, schema-mismatched, or non-loopback artifacts fail closed (BLOCKED). The detached HMAC-SHA256 signature lives in the adjacent .sig file, not in this document.

schema_version.description: RoE schema version. Only version 1 validates.

operator.description: Human operator accountable for engagements under this artifact.

authorized_targets.description: Explicit host/tool scope list. Every host must be loopback.

host.description: Target host. Only 127.0.0.1 and localhost validate.

tools.description: Optional tool scope subset for this host.

effective_from.description: RFC3339 start of the authorization window (inclusive).

effective_until.description: RFC3339 end of the authorization window (inclusive).

case_classes.description: Simulation classes this artifact authorizes (subset of the six).
